verdict.rationale: Parsec documents near-zero latency, frame rates up to 240 FPS, 4:4:4 color and Wacom pressure/tilt support for interactive work. A community user corroborates smooth, near-60fps sessions good enough for gaming over 4G. Nothing in the evidence says the stream is hardware-encoded, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: any documentation of hardware (GPU) encoding, and measured latency figures or independent latency benchmarks.

support.subject: As a power user, the stream is hardware-encoded and low-latency enough for interactive work, not just passive viewing

citations.quote: a seamless 4k experience at up to 60 frames per second with near-zero latency
Get frame rates up to 240 FPS (up to 60 FPS at 4K), for a silky smooth experience.
Full Wacom tablet support with pressure + tilt
The remote desktop experience on Parsec is smooth and close to 60fps. I can even play games from my PC over 4G network.
